Marta (Growth): Idea: run a tiny PLG launch called "Mini-Lab" 15min demo + 25min hands-on lab + 3 micro-posts + credit timing A/B. Goal: bump 7d activations (>=1k tokens).
Eli (Design): Two hero angles: "Hands-on in an hour" vs "Lower inference cost". I'll mock two small GIFs and a compact benchmark card.
Chen (Product): Deliverable = working endpoint + 3 persona prompt snippets. Send attendees a starter prompt pack. Experiment: CREDIT_NOW vs CREDIT_AFTER at signup.
Rita (Eng): Implementation: add credit_arm field to form (NOW|AFTER), tag cohort=mini-lab-jun, emit event when 7d_tokens >=1000 to route to growth-sales.
signup-bot: Form live -> 29 regs in 90m, CTR 3.7% :sparkles:
Marta (Growth): Draft social copy quick edit:
Short A: "Build an LLM feature in an hour. Join Mini-Lab + claim starter credits: https://redwood.ai/minilab"
Short B: "Reduce inference cost, ship faster. Live Mini-Lab + prompt pack. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/minilab"
Eli (Design): A is social-first, B for LinkedIn. I'll do GIFs + benchmark card by tomorrow morning.
Chen (Product): I'll own agenda & prompt pack. Hypothesis: NOW ups attendance, AFTER ups post-event activation. We'll randomize evenly.
Rita (Eng): I'll wire the flag, routing, and push 50/95/99p latencies + per-token cost for the small model by EOD. Routing rule draft: {source:mini_lab_form,tags:[cohort:mini-lab-jun],route_to:growth-sales,route_if:{7d_tokens:>=1000},fallback:nurture-email}
Marta (Growth): Metrics: registration -> attendance, attendance -> 7d tokens, activation rate (>1k tokens). Primary KPI = activation within 7d. Action items: Eli assets, Chen agenda, Rita routing/metrics, Marta ads + tracking. Dry run 24h prior. Thanks :thumbsup:
